reasons.realCost: The real bill at each size matches its plan's published annual price exactly ($17, $29 and $39/mo) because Wix caps costs with fixed collaborator and storage tiers rather than metering bandwidth or per-seat fees.
reasons.pricingHonesty: Wix's public pricing page shows only the annual, paid-in-full price for every paid plan; the true month-to-month rate is disclosed only after selecting a plan inside a logged-in account.
reasons.smallTeamFit: The free plan and drag-and-drop editor let a non-technical owner build and preview a full site with no credit card and no developer.
reasons.doesTheJob: Online payments, customer accounts and a full eCommerce toolkit only start at the Core plan, so the cheapest Light tier can't run a store at all.
reasons.freedomToLeave: Wix is a closed platform: a site cannot be exported as a whole, leaving an owner limited to exporting CMS collections as CSV, downloading media individually, and copying page text by hand.
reasons.trackRecord: Wix has been a public company on Nasdaq (WIX) since 2013 and runs a public status page, with its Help Center reporting 99.99% uptime across its sites.

basis: Wix is easy for a non-technical owner and its real bills match the published price at each size, but hiding the true month-to-month rate behind a login and offering no full-site export make it a weaker exit than its rivals.
method: Two separate AI passes (two runs of Anthropic's Claude over the same evidence, neither seeing the other's score) scored six factors (1–5) and an overall; published overall is the lower of the two overall scores, because this tool runs an affiliate program we have joined or may join. Pass scores: 3.4 and 3.4.
